sources.shortExcerpt: It's billed as an AI Observability event, not as a Product Analytics event.
sources.conclusion: 所有 $ai_ 事件按 AI Observability 计费，不再按 Product Analytics 事件计费。包括自定义 $ai_ 名称；额外 $ai_span/$ai_trace 仍属于 AI 事件计量。
成功 observation 的固定模型价格是2/5/15 credits；Gemini 3 Flash为5，credits记录在 $recording_observed 事件。免费计划额度耗尽后停止扫描。
